part4.audio_script: Hello, Mr. Tanaka. This is Clara from the Event Planning Committee. I'm calling to inform you of a sudden change regarding the Financial Strategies Seminar you are attending this Friday. Unfortunately, our venue at the Grand Hotel experienced a water leak this morning, so we have to relocate the event. The seminar will now be held at the Riverside Convention Center, just two blocks away. The start time has also been pushed back by 30 minutes to 9:30 A.M. to allow attendees extra travel time. I have emailed you a revised map and schedule. Please let me know if you have any questions.
